teachingQuestion: How does raw telemetry become trustworthy operational action?
focalInsight: Collection without normalization, protection, correlation, retention, and triage produces noise rather than usable evidence.
title: Logging to action
caption: Security telemetry gains value through context, integrity, and ownership.

nodes.label: Event sources
nodes.detail: Identity, endpoint, app, network, cloud, physical

altSummary: Events from many sources are collected and normalized, protected and retained, correlated and monitored, then triaged into response actions.
textFallback: Collect security-relevant events with actor, action, object, result, source, time, and correlation fields. Protect and retain them, correlate them against context and baselines, and route actionable signals to an owner with a response playbook.
